items.title: 4.9.1 Tibb (medicine) mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.9.1, printed page 91, with a self-check.

blocks.text: Stoichiometry medicine (tibb) ke maidan mein bohat aham hai aur in kaamon mein istemal hoti hai:

items: Antibiotics banate waqt stoichiometry yaqeeni banati hai ke har dose mein active ingredient sahi miqdar mein ho aur target bacteria ke mutabiq ho.
Mareezon ke khoon mein cholesterol ki satah (level) maloom karne ke liye. Cholesterol charbi (fat) ki ek qism hai jo sari buri nahi, lekin nuqsan bhi de sakti hai.
Diabetes ke mareez ke khoon mein glucose ka level maloom karne ke liye. Insulin ka istemal blood sugar ko theek control karne ke liye stoichiometry par depend karta hai.
Khiladiyon (athletes) ke peshab (urine) mein steroids aur doosre stimulants (jism ko tez karne wali dawaein) pakarne ke liye. Khiladi inhein karkardagi aur taqat barhane ke liye lete hain.
Vaccine banate waqt viral antigens ki concentration maloom karne ke liye, taake vaccine asar kare.

Mareez ko dawa ki kitni miqdar aur kitni dafa deni hai, yeh tai karne ke liye. Kam miqdar mein dawa be-asar hoti hai, aur zyada miqdar zehreeli (toxic) halat ya maut ka sabab ban sakti hai. Paracetamol dard aur bukhar kam karne ke liye hai; is ki overdose khoon patla kar sakti hai aur aaza (organs), khaas taur par jigar (liver), ko shadeed nuqsan pohncha sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Paracetamol ki sahi dose kyun aham hai, aur pharmacist dose nikalte waqt stoichiometry ka kaun sa khayal istemal karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Bohat kam paracetamol be-asar hai, aur overdose khoon patla kar ke jigar aur doosre aaza ko nuqsan deti hai. Pharmacist mass, molar mass, moles aur concentration ke taalluq se mareez ke liye active ingredient ki theek miqdar nikalta hai.

items: Stoichiometry antibiotic doses tai karti hai, khoon mein cholesterol aur glucose naapti hai, khiladiyon mein steroids pakarti hai, vaccine mein antigen ki concentration tai karti hai, aur mehfooz dose nikalti hai (paracetamol overdose jigar ko nuqsan deti hai).
